thread:
arjun: Quick follow-up from the auth postmortem. We surfaced three recurring gaps: intermittent refresh-token rejects, missing delete events in audit log, and secret-rotation gaps for service accounts. Proposing owners and timelines.
emma: I'll pick up refresh-token validation. Plan: reproduce, add stricter schema checks, and add a small migration to validate persisted tokens. Target: 10d.
lucas: Taking audit logging gaps. Will add delete event emission for token/service secrets and bake in RBAC checks for read access to the audit index. ETA 5d.
nina: I'll run the secrets rotation playbook and add canary rotations for 2 critical service keys. Also will document rollback steps. ETA 2 wks.
arjun: Can we also add an automated regression test that simulates monthly usage spikes? This keeps coming back.
emma: Yes, adding a load-pattern test and an alert rule: `auth.unexpected_spike` with 10m window.
lucas: For audit, adding a dashboard and retention verification. Will ensure events include `actor`, `resource_id`, `action`, `result`.
infra-bot: Noted deploy risk: change in token serializer in commit 3c4a1e may affect migration. Tagging infra for canary.
audit-bot: New alert channel created: #sec-audit-notify.
arjun: Action items summary:
- INF-8123 (emma) 	6 refresh-token validation + migration 	6 10d
- AUD-8124 (lucas) 	6 emit delete events + RBAC checks + dashboard 	6 5d
- SECR-301 (nina) 	6 canary rotations + runbook updates 	6 14d
- TEST-940 (emma/infra) 	6 monthly-spike regression test + alerting 	6 7d
Please ack owners and realistic ETAs.
emma: Acked.
lucas: Acked.
nina: Acked, will coordinate with infra for key access.
arjun: I'll add these to the postmortem doc and create a weekly check-in for progress (Tues 9am). Also tagging product for visibility.
emma: I'll post unit test coverage and a short repro in the ticket tomorrow.
lucas: Dashboard link will be in AUD-8124 once ready.
infra-bot: Canary pipeline scheduled on staging for 2026-05-04.
arjun: Thanks team. Will follow up in the weekly.
